motivation: Accuracy-first reset after I027. Determine which exported B31J intersection declarations actually own flexibility, prove the locked bend-angle population and current smooth-90 basis, and demonstrate that CAESAR load-case formula text does not uniquely identify the solved state. No beam/shear/bend/tee candidate is introduced in this iteration.
authorityNotes: Hexagon B31J Methods locates run flexibility at the run/branch centerline intersection and branch flexibility at the run surface; CAESAR creates a branch surface node and fictitious rigid element for the branch leg.
Hexagon states B31J smooth 90-degree bends use 1.3/h while the general B31.3 bend basis uses 1.65/h.
Hexagon states load-case Elastic Modulus and elbow stiffening controls participate in stiffness and are not encoded completely by the CASE formula text.
B31J rotational flexibility factors at or below 1.0 are treated as rigid; stress/SIF declarations are not by themselves proof of a flexibility spring.

observedResult.topologyAdjudication: The automated type-only audit initially labels the five two-element TYPE=3/5 records as B31J tee flexibility candidates. They are not promoted to a missing-flexibility defect: the locked topology has no third branch leg at those nodes and no BRANCHNODE, while CAESAR B31J tee flexibility is defined on interacting run and branch legs with a branch surface node/fictitious rigid. They remain SIF/component declarations to preserve for stress authority, not an invented branch stiffness in this L19/L20 flexibility solve.
observedResult.vendorB31JSmooth90Coefficient: 1.3/h when Use Smooth 90 Degree Bend Correction is active

defaultRestraintStiffnessComplianceBound.interpretation: Exact fixed-DOF replacement is numerically negligible at the locked reaction scale and is not a priority root cause.

observedResult.coldModulus: EC is the correct L19/L20 flexibility authority; EC==EH1 in this locked ACCDB, so I016 remains numerically neutral.

decisionReason: I028 eliminates several lower-value hypotheses and identifies the next clean mechanics variable. The five typed intersection records outside the current TYPE=3 three-leg implementation lack physical three-leg branch topology and are not promoted to invented flexibility springs. Default 1e13 restraint stiffness is orders of magnitude too stiff to explain the response gap. Every bend is exactly 90 degrees, 13/20 baseline L19 source-action failure rows are bend-adjacent, and the frozen solver explicitly disables the B31J smooth-90 correction, thereby selecting 1.65/h. The next admissible experiment is therefore a controlled Boolean smooth-90 A/B using the vendor-defined 1.3/h rule while all other mechanics are frozen. Same-formula CAESAR case differences are retained as a separate architecture finding: formula text alone is not a complete load-case mechanics authority.
